colors.note: 12-24: brand hue + tints, accent, greys, status

spacing.note: off-scale values; a dozen deliberate exceptions

typefaces.note: sans for UI, serif accent, mono for code

fontSizes.note: a type scale, up to 10 steps

nearPairs.note: near-identical colours are copy-paste, not decisions

neverImported.note: a system component nobody imports is dead weight

arbitrary.note: bracket escape hatches; a handful of deliberate exceptions

paintTin.note: palette colours in own code where a theme variable exists, per 100 files

doorOverrides.note: shadcn components given a colour or font through className, per 100 files

referenceSystems.note: Curated scoped scans of reputable public design systems. Not comparable head-to-head with product repos: see per-system notes.

systems.name: shadcn/ui
systems.note: zero raw values by design; tokens live in one theme file, components use semantic utilities

systems.name: Primer
systems.note: colour count inflated by hex fallbacks in var() and vendored multi-theme palettes

systems.name: Polaris
systems.note: tokens live in the separate polaris-tokens package outside this scope

systems.name: Carbon
systems.note: styling lives in separate Sass packages, so colour and radii counts are near zero

systems.name: Material UI
systems.note: colour count is the reference palette shipped as JS; CSS-in-JS theme values are invisible

systems.name: Chakra UI
systems.note: colour count is the token definitions themselves; CSS-in-JS hides spacing and radii

systems.name: Ant Design
systems.note: inline style count is dominated by demos co-located with components

systems.name: GOV.UK Frontend
systems.note: Nunjucks + Sass, so component count is zero by scanner definition; colours are the full government palette

systems.name: Adobe Spectrum
systems.note: styling lives in separate spectrum-css packages; duplicate count is mostly re-export patterns

systems.name: Cloudscape
systems.note: token-driven SCSS keeps colours low; shadow count comes from elevation and motion scss

shadcn.note: every repo in the fleet the scanner reads as shadcn; the "cleaner than" line on a shadcn repo reads against these
